description: This file defines an enumeration DaysInYearType that represents different types of days-in-year conventions for financial calculations, such as actual days, 360, 364, and 365 day years. It includes methods for retrieving values, converting from integers, and checking if the type is 'actual'.

classes.name: DaysInYearType
classes.description: An enum representing different conventions for days in a year used in interest calculations.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for all enum constants except INVALID.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Creates a DaysInYearType enum constant from an integer value.

methods.name: isActual
methods.description: Checks if the enum constant represents the 'actual' days-in-year type.

methods.name: getNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for the given reference date, or the fixed value if not 'actual'.
